title: My Flashcards
text:
I have a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on the front and a picture on the back. I study with my cards every day. My sister uses them too.

Today I learned the word 'dog'. I look at the picture of a dog. Then I say the word out loud. I like my flashcards very much.

questions.text: What is on the back of each card?
What word did the writer learn today?
Why does the writer study every day?
How does the writer probably feel about flashcards?

vocabulary.definition: small cards with a word or picture used for learning
a drawing or photo that shows something
a single unit of language that has a meaning

paragraph_translations: Bir kutu kelime kartım var. Her kartın ön yüzünde bir kelime, arka yüzünde bir resim var. Her gün kartlarımla çalışıyorum. Kız kardeşim de onları kullanıyor.
Bugün 'dog' kelimesini öğrendim. Bir köpeğin resmine bakıyorum. Sonra kelimeyi yüksek sesle söylüyorum. Kelime kartlarımı çok seviyorum.
